run_pr_slow_ci_models: run pr_slow_ci_models.py to get the list of models requiring slow CI for a pull request
run_pr_slow_ci_models_with_message: run pr_slow_ci_models.py with a GitHub comment message to extract models from run-slow directives
run_pr_slow_ci_models_quantization: run pr_slow_ci_models.py with --quantization flag to collect quantization test models
get_new_python_files_between_commits: get new python files added between a base commit and a list of commits in the transformers repo
get_new_model_from_diff: get the new model name from newly added modeling files between current head and main branch
parse_run_slow_message: parse a GitHub PR comment message to extract model names after run-slow, run_slow, or run slow prefix
check_model_name_validity: validate a model name contains only allowed characters and does not start or end with underscore
